steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Take this!
Hella swings her steel pipe, slamming it into the bandit's gun before striking his face.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hell yeah! Another point for Hella!
The bandit stumbles back, clutching his nose. He then steadies himself and roars in fury.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: Damn! You really want to have things the hard way, huh? Bring out the weapons, boys!
Three cannons simultaneously rise from behind them, all aimed at Hella.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...For f**k's sake...

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: Heh, this is some good stuff from DisCity. Just three shells, and we'll blow this dump to smithereens...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Shameless!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: Haha! In WhiteSands, the only sin is weakness!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: Instead of bickering with me, kiddo, why not check on your "companions"?
Hella suddenly senses something wrong. She turns around and sees the townsfolk surrounded by the bandits.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: Now, make your choice... Would you rather die under these cannons, or surrender the Hypercubes and beg for a quick death?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Surrender? Heh. In your f**king dream!
The bandit's threat doesn't work. Hella steps forward heroically, standing at the front of the crowd, using her body to shield the townsfolk.
She hates being framed for no reason, and despises bullies even more. She doesn't care who stole the bandits' looted Hypercube; she just wants to beat them to a pulp with her steel pipe.
Plus, her confidence stems from one more thing.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'm not fighting alone here, okay? Two Sinners against you losers... it'll be an easy peasy fight!
The desert bandit is stunned for a moment, then bursts into laughter.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: Ha... hahaha, alright, I get it... so that's how it is...

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: You talkin' about innocence, huh? We ain't good guys though, but that wench with the gun... she prolly didn't get her Hypercube in a clean way either.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Stop your bull***tting! Throwing dirt 'cause you can't win? Well listen up, your spinning won't work on us...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Right, Korryn?
Hella turns and spots Korryn at the back of the crowd... This "trusty friend" is trying to sneak over the wall, one leg already in the air..
Korryn turns her head stiffly, locking eyes with Hella.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Eh...What are you doing?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The enemy's over here, where are you going...?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Hahaha... That was quick. You guys done talking already?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Don't mind me. Take all the time you need... Hella darling, you were super cool just now! Hang in there! Tuco is in your hands!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: I've got something else to attend to. Be back in a jiffy~
Korryn blows a kiss and nimbly flips over the wall in the next moment, vanishing completely.
...Poor little Hella is left behind, dumbfounded, to face the fierce desert bandits alone.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: Ha! Only one obstacle left... Aim the cannons at her! Ready to fire!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ah...Huh?? You big liar!!!!
